# Guards — Evidence

<!-- Generated by `tyto-docs-engine build-evidence`. Do not edit. -->

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-guards.4eafa1c9"></a>**1. GoogleAuthGuard is an @Injectable() NestJS guard that extends AuthGuard('google') from @nestjs/passport to provide Google OAuth authentication, and it depends on IpBlockingService injected through its constructor.**
  [`google-auth.guard.ts:1-12`](../google-auth.guard.ts#L1-L12)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-guards.0a33100e"></a>**2. IpBlockingGuard is an @Injectable() NestJS guard implementing CanActivate that blocks access from IPs that IpBlockingService reports as blocked.**
  [`ip-blocking.guard.ts:11-18`](../ip-blocking.guard.ts#L11-L18)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-guards.5f7d220b"></a>**3. Both GoogleAuthGuard and IpBlockingGuard are imported by backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts, which uses them as route guards.**
  [`auth.controller.ts:22-23`](../../auth.controller.ts#L22-L23)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-guards.f676ae38"></a>**4. GoogleAuthGuard.canActivate delegates to the parent passport guard's canActivate; when authentication succeeds it clears any recorded failed attempts for the client IP via IpBlockingService.clearFailedAttempts and triggers a session login via super.logIn(request).**
  [`google-auth.guard.ts:14-29`](../google-auth.guard.ts#L14-L29)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-guards.8c0afe00"></a>**5. GoogleAuthGuard.canActivate catches authentication failures, records a failed attempt for the client IP via IpBlockingService.recordFailedAttempt, logs a warning when the service reports the IP should be blocked, and re-throws the original error.**
  [`google-auth.guard.ts:30-43`](../google-auth.guard.ts#L30-L43)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-guards.2b44575c"></a>**6. IpBlockingGuard.canActivate checks IpBlockingService.isBlocked(ip); when the IP is blocked it computes the time until unblock, logs a warning with the reason and blocked-at timestamp, and throws a ForbiddenException with statusCode 403, message 'IP_BLOCKED', a human-readable error stating the minutes remaining, and retryAfter in seconds.**
  [`ip-blocking.guard.ts:20-44`](../ip-blocking.guard.ts#L20-L44)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-guards.80e32637"></a>**7. IpBlockingGuard is imported by backend/src/auth/auth.module.ts, which registers it as a provider and an export of the AuthModule.**
  [`auth.module.ts:8-8`](../../auth.module.ts#L8-L8)
  [`auth.module.ts:17-24`](../../auth.module.ts#L17-L24)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-guards.f289afb7"></a>**8. GoogleAuthGuard.getAuthenticateOptions reads returnUrl from the request query and returns it as a JSON-stringified state option so it survives the OAuth redirect.**
  [`google-auth.guard.ts:50-58`](../google-auth.guard.ts#L50-L58)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-guards.43ae735e"></a>**9. GoogleAuthGuard.getClientIp extracts the client IP from the X-Forwarded-For header, taking the first entry when the header lists multiple IPs, and falls back to request.ip, then request.socket.remoteAddress, then the literal 'unknown'.**
  [`google-auth.guard.ts:64-75`](../google-auth.guard.ts#L64-L75)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-guards.7518b4ff"></a>**10. IpBlockingGuard.getClientIp extracts the client IP from the X-Forwarded-For header, taking the first entry when the header lists multiple IPs, and falls back to request.ip, then request.socket.remoteAddress, then the literal 'unknown'.**
  [`ip-blocking.guard.ts:53-64`](../ip-blocking.guard.ts#L53-L64)
